title: Fix event bus unsubscription and once semantics
instruction: Fix src/bus.mjs (EventBus) and src/once.mjs (once helper). on(event, handler) returns an unsubscribe function that removes exactly that registration; calling it twice is harmless. emit(event, payload) calls handlers in registration order with the payload, iterating over a snapshot so handlers that unsubscribe during emit do not cause others to be skipped; emit returns the number of handlers called. once(bus, event, handler) registers a handler that runs at most once and then unsubscribes itself; once returns its unsubscribe function too. The same function may be registered twice and then runs twice.

materialDefectsInFixture: mutating array during emit skips handlers
